  • Real feedback on your own work — not a video library. Every piece you submit gets genuine, personal attention, not a generic template.
  • A genuine path, beginner to exhibition-ready — structured lessons that build on each other, all the way to a real UAH exhibition.
  • Honest, never generic — praise when it's earned, one clear thing to work on when it isn't, always specific to what you actually made.
  • Try it before you commit — one side-shoot piece is free, no account needed, so you can see how it feels first.
  • Built by a real gallery, not a platform — Ulverston Art House is a working gallery and framing studio, not a faceless tech company.
  • £15 a month, or £150 a year — no hidden pricing, no surprise paywall halfway through signup. Less than a single evening class costs for one term.

Side-shoots are theme-based modules where you'll be guided to create a piece of art to proudly hang on your wall.

A few honest answers
Is the feedback genuinely personal, or just generic AI output?

Genuinely personal. The AI looks at your actual photo, every time — not a script or a template. It tells you honestly when something's working and gives you one real thing to try next, specific to what you actually made. If a piece is already excellent, it says so, rather than inventing a fix nobody needs.

What happens to my images? Is my work still mine?

Completely yours, always. We never claim any rights over what you create — copyright stays with you, full stop. If you'd ever like a piece shown in our community gallery, that's entirely optional, and something you'd choose yourself.

I've genuinely never drawn before — is this actually for me?

Yes, more than for anyone else. This course exists for people who'd normally say "I can't draw" or "I'm just not creative." You're creating more than you realise already — this just gives it real structure, and someone paying proper attention.

Can I try it before paying anything?

Yes — one side-shoot piece is completely free, with real feedback, no card required. See how it actually feels before deciding on anything.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes, anytime, no minimum commitment.

How is this different from something like Skillshare?

Skillshare and similar platforms give you videos to watch — genuinely useful, but nobody ever actually looks at what you make. Here, every piece you submit gets real, individual feedback. That's the whole point.

Can I actually sell what I make here?

Yes — separately from the Academy, Ulverston Art House also runs a real seller marketplace. Once you've made something you're proud of, you can register as a vendor and start selling it yourself, right on the same site. Create it here, sell it here too.
